$comment: Record of the adaptive file/folder/save chooser fix for root integration and qualification. Every result below was measured in this clone; nothing here was run on a Pixel, iPhone, MacBook or any other device, and nothing was installed or published.

commits.d714877: File choosers: one app-owned adaptive chooser for every open, save and folder entry point (code, tests, 50 catalogs, docs, design evidence)

final_source_ready_note: Source, tests, catalogs, docs and design evidence are complete and pass on d714877 in this clone (host x86_64, Debug, offscreen). Root still owns the integration merge, the release/ARM64 builds, CTest as a whole, rust-core, and any install.
user_report: Remaining Qt fallback dialogs at 175 % (global font 23 px): folder chooser 600x400, file dialogs 600x497/542, 16 px icons, path/name/filter controls clipped. Evidence: /home/maslos/Work/tomacco-project-picker-fix-20261107/.scratch/evidence/other/other-dialogs.json and other-*-175.png (Choose a web build 600x400; Import settings, Install app on device, Import device profiles 600x497; Export settings 600x542).
root_cause: 23 entry points declared QtQuick.Dialogs FileDialog/FolderDialog. On this desktop Qt uses its non-native Quick Dialogs fallback, which opens a separate window of fixed size and lays out its own controls from Qt's style, independent of Tomacco's Theme.uiScale; only the application font grew with the interface size, so text outgrew the fixed window and its one-line fields. The project chooser alone had already been replaced (ProjectFolderDialog, 2026-11-07).

implementation.shared_component: qml/FileChooserDialog.qml: a StudioDialog (theme tokens, StudioButton/StudioCheckBox/StudioComboBox/StudioScrollView) with mode open | save | folder. ProjectFolderDialog.qml is now a 30-line form of it (mode folder, folderTarget = Backend::projectFolder, startAt = beside the open project, markPath, namePrefix projectFolder) with its object names, properties (listing, target, rowHeight, sheet, insets, openWith, caption, defaultTitle) and chosen(path) signal unchanged.
implementation.backend: src/backend.{h,cpp}: folderListing and the new fileListing share one listing() (same natural, locale-aware order incl. the C-locale fallback; folderListing output unchanged, no files key). New: fileListing(typed, base, hidden, patterns) adds matching files (case-insensitive wildcards, links to files with their canonical target, broken links and dot-files left out unless hidden); filterPatterns("Videos (*.mp4 *.mov)") -> ["*.mp4","*.mov"] as Qt's qt_clean_filter_list; pathInfo(path) {exists (broken links count), folder, file, link, readable, writable}; saveTarget(name, base, defaultSuffix): typed name or path (relative, absolute, ~/, file: URL), neither trimmed nor resolved, suffix added only to a name without a dot that is no folder (Qt's rule), a trailing / names a folder; fileUrl(path) = QUrl::fromLocalFile.
implementation.layout: Location (path) and file name are wrapping mono TextAreas (up to 3 lines, scrolling beyond), left-aligned also under RTL mirroring; Parent/Home (icon-only and named when narrow), Hidden; list of folders then files (whole names, wrap, link target in mono, plain text); file name; File type combobox with wrapping label and choices; problem line; foot Flow (accent action at the end side, natural widths, wraps instead of squeezing). Body scrolls; foot stays. Desktop: centred, up to 760x640 logical px x scale. Sheet (whole window, 48 px targets, 16 px text) below 600 logical px of width or 480 of height; insets from the window's SafeArea (probe item on the window content item) and the on-screen keyboard (Qt.inputMethod); the focused file name is scrolled into view when the room changes.

behaviour.open: Click on a file row names it (no choice); double click, Enter on a highlighted file, Ctrl+Enter or Open choose an existing readable regular file (link path kept). A typed folder name enters the folder; a pasted file path shows its folder and names it. Unreadable file: Open off, message. Filters only narrow the listing (a typed existing file of another type is accepted, as Qt's dialogs did).
behaviour.save: Typed name (or path) in the shown folder; default suffix as saveTarget; a folder name enters the folder; a missing parent folder disables Save with a message; an existing target (also a broken link) opens the replace question with No focused (focus ring visible): Yes chooses, No/Escape close only the question and keep name and folder. The chooser never writes, creates or deletes a file.
behaviour.folder: Folders only; Open chooses the folder the location names (as browsed, links not resolved); a file path or missing path shows the error and Open is off.
behaviour.cancel: Cancel, Escape (and closing) emit rejected; accepted (and so every caller's onAccepted request/render/import/export/install) only ever follows choose() with a valid target.

implementation.keyboard: Ctrl+L location (select all), Enter in location = show (or name a typed file), Ctrl+Enter = choose, Alt+Up/Backspace/Left = parent, Right/Enter on folder = enter, Up/Down highlight (a file is named), Tab/Backtab move on, Escape cancels (or closes only the replace question).
implementation.text_safety: Every name, path and message Text is Text.PlainText; in a right-to-left interface a path inside a sentence and a filter's wildcards are isolated (U+2066..U+2069).

entry_point_notes: All 23 former stock uses keep their caller, button, title, file types, default suffix (none where there was none) and accept action; only the path conversion changed: callers read selectedPath (the plain local path) instead of decodeURIComponent(selectedFile.toString().replace(/^file:\/\//,"")), which gave the same string for every valid path (#, %, spaces, Unicode; checked in backend test via QUrl::fromPercentEncoding). Main.qml's web build still passes selectedFolder (a file: URL) to Studio.serveFolder.
Callers without a stock title got an existing text of their own context; no caller text was added.
import QtQuick.Dialogs is gone from all 10 files; no MessageDialog/ColorDialog/FontDialog was used anywhere.
DemoWorkspace.localPath(url), only used by the stock dialogs, was removed; DemoWorkspace.fileUrl is unchanged.

NativeWorkspace's three choosers no longer bind sheet/insets to view.phone: they use the component's own rule (sheet below 600 px wide or 480 px high, SafeArea and keyboard insets), like every other caller. The project chooser keeps its tested sheet:view.phone and view insets.
preserved_contracts: Project chooser: all object names (projectFolderDialog*, projectFolderName/Link), properties and signal; the existing desktop (15 sizes, navigation, de/ar/ja) and phone (6 sizes) project chooser tests pass unchanged.
folderListing output and natural C-locale ordering (backend tests theProjectChooser* unchanged and passing).
No operation, policy, approval, reservation or request-id code changed; requests are sent only from the callers' unchanged onAccepted handlers.
User zoom is respected: everything scales from Theme (uiScale); nothing clamps or resets the interface size.

Deliberate breakages of qml/FileChooserDialog.qml, each caught and reverted: no replace question -> save test fails at the question; no default suffix -> save test fails on the target; Cancel choosing -> cancel test fails on accepted. Regressions found and fixed during this work, each caught by the new tests or the rendered screenshots: overlay probe blocking Ctrl+O (project chooser test), stale current row in onCurrentIndexChanged (open test), sheet text fields below 48 px (fit test), focused name not kept in view on keyboard/resize (phone test), first listing ignoring the file type (open test after reordering), squeezed/elided foot buttons and RTL name alignment (screenshots; tests tightened to assert both).

Incident: the 'Cancel choosing' mutant ran in the isolated test app and accepted the first dialog (install), so one device.install request with a synthetic .json path and no device reached the isolated test control plane (build tomaccoctl, private TOMACCO_HOME). Its trap log shows only the usual discovery probes (adb devices -l x4, idevice_id -l x2, xtool, agent CLIs); no install command ran and no device was reachable. No further mutant touched a dispatching caller.

limitations: No real-device qualification: the phone sheet, SafeArea insets (read through a probe item) and the on-screen keyboard inset were exercised only offscreen with simulated insets; nothing ran on the Pixel.

The project chooser keeps its own sheet rule (NativeWorkspace view.phone, width only) to preserve its tested contract, so in a short landscape window it stays a centred dialog while every other chooser becomes a sheet. Aligning it is a small follow-up.
Filters narrow only the listing; a typed existing file of another type is accepted, and no extension is changed when the file type is switched (as Qt's dialogs; a name is never changed silently).
A save into a folder that exists but is not writable is not refused by the chooser; the caller's operation reports the error, as before.
The chooser does not show sizes or dates and offers no rename, delete or new-folder actions (out of scope by request).
Translations of the five new texts are machine-authored, not native-speaker reviewed.
The ordered-chunk dependence of two existing desktop tests (see tests.pre_existing_order_dependence) remains.
